title: DNA Extraction Protocol for Yeast PacBio Sequencing
author: Douda Bensasson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rved63e
materials: Pool samples for each strain and remove RNA from purified DNA. (modified from Qiagen's protocol, Apendix D ) *I am pretty sure any ethanol precipitation protocol would be fine here. I only used the protocol and 'Protein Precipitation Solution' from Qiagen because it was to hand.

Pool samples for each strain and remove RNA from purified DNA. (modified from Qiagen's protocol, Apendix D ) *I am pretty sure any ethanol precipitation protocol would be fine here. I only used the protocol and 'Protein Precipitation Solution' from Qiagen because it was to hand.

steps.title: Grow overnight yeast culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 15 ml YPD in a 50 ml Falcon tube from a single colony on a YPD plate using a sterile loop, then incubate overnight at 30 °C for at least 20 h (e.g., 24 h).

steps.title: Harvest cells (first round)
steps.instruction: Transfer 1.4 ml of the overnight culture into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube; repeat eight times per strain (total 8 tubes). Centrifuge at high speed (14 000 rpm on an Eppendorf or 16 162 g on other) for 2 min, discard the supernatant into a yeast‑waste jar containing Virkon solution (Virkon powder mixed with water to a deep pink color).

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in EDTA
steps.instruction: Resuspend each cell pellet in 296 µl 50 mM EDTA, pH 8.

steps.title: Lyticase digestion
steps.instruction: Add 4 µl Lyticase (25 U/µl, diluted stock from Sigma; 100 U total) to each tube and incubate overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Pellet after digestion
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16 162 g for 2 min, then discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Cell lysis and protein precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 300 µl Promega Nuclei Lysis Solution followed by 100 µl Promega Protein Precipitation Solution; stir with the pipette tip and pipette up‑and‑down to resuspend the pellet (the mixture becomes cloudy). Incubate on ice for 5–30 min, then centrifuge at high speed for 10 min.

steps.title: Isopropanol DNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the cleared supernatant to a clean 1.5 ml tube containing 300 µl isopropanol, avoiding the protein pellet and leaving a small residual liquid. Invert the tube 50 times (a wispy mass may become visible), then centrifuge at high speed for 10 min.

steps.title: Ethanol wash and drying (first)
steps.instruction: Carefully pipette off and discard the supernatant without dislodging the pellet; drain on clean absorbent paper. Add 300 µl room‑temperature 70 % ethanol and gently invert 20 times to wash the DNA pellet. Centrifuge at 16 162 g for 5 min, pipette off all ethanol, drain on absorbent paper and air‑dry the pellet for 15 min.

steps.title: DNA rehydration and RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 25 µl Promega DNA Rehydration Solution and gently resuspend the pellet by pipetting. Add 1.5 µl Promega RNase solution (or 1:2 diluted Qiagen RNase, 5.25 U, Cat. no. 19101) and mix. Incubate at 37 °C for 1–2 h, vortex for 1 s and spin briefly to collect liquid.

steps.title: Overnight storage and gel check
steps.instruction: Leave the extracts at room temperature overnight, then store at 2–8 °C until ethanol precipitation (may be several days). Check each sample on an agarose gel; discard any sample where 1 µl is not visible.

steps.title: Cool and spin before pooling
steps.instruction: Cool DNA extracts on ice for 15 min, then spin at high speed for 10 min.

steps.title: Pool extracts and hydrate
steps.instruction: Pool the supernatants of the four extracts for each strain into a fresh tube (final volume ≈180 µl). Add 20 µl (or other amount) Promega (or Qiagen) DNA Hydration Solution to bring the volume to 200 µl per strain.

steps.title: Second RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 6 µl RNase A from Promega (or 3 µl RNase A solution from Qiagen), mix by pipetting, vortex 1 s and spin. Incubate at 37 °C for 1 h, then transfer to ice.

steps.title: Protein precipitation and ethanol precipitation (second round)
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl Promega (or Qiagen) Protein Precipitation Solution (0.5 × volume) and 400 µl 96–100 % ethanol (2 × volume) from the freezer. Invert 50 times, then place on ice for 15 min. Centrifuge at high speed for 10 min.

steps.title: Ethanol wash and drying (second)
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl room‑temperature 70 % ethanol (3 × volume), centrifuge at high speed for 3 min, carefully pipette off and discard supernatant, then air‑dry the pellet for 15 min.

steps.title: Final resuspension and incubation
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 110 µl Qiagen DNA Hydration Solution (1× TE) by gentle pipetting. Incubate at 37 °C for 1–1.5 h to fully dissolve DNA. Perform a quick spin, pipette to mix, and let stand at room temperature for 15 min.

steps.title: Final cleanup and quality control
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at high speed for 10 min to pellet any remaining impurities. Transfer the supernatant to new tubes (no pellet should be visible). Assess DNA quality and quantity by running 0.5 % agarose gel with GeneRuler High Range DNA Ladder (SM1351) stained with 1× GelRed in 1× TAE, measuring absorbance with NanoDrop, and quantifying with a Qubit fluorometer.
